Biopsy timepoint 2: The specimen contains adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. Perineural invasion is absent. The tumour is located in the transition zone, right.

The histological findings show an upgrade from ISUP grade group 1 to ISUP grade group 2 across the two biopsy timepoints.
